This maize plot is small but the soil here in the middle belt responds well when I put fertilizer. I will buy one bag of NPK and a little urea — I always put fertilizer on my maize because without it the cobs are poor. I will use my own seed from last year, like I always do, since the agro-dealer seed costs too much and I cannot read the packet. My wife and I will do most of the work ourselves, but I may call one or two young men for clearing.
